svg.aria-label: Optional mirrored and multi-peak reference families
svg.title: Optional mirrored and multi-peak reference families
svg.desc: Each case supplies one candidate prefix and two branches. The double-bottom candidate and completed branch mirror the core closes as 110 minus price; its invalidated branch is separately supplied. Head/shoulders diagrams use the dated 55/56 trough neckline (inverted D4 = $55/D8 = $54 for the bottom); these catalogue sketches do not specify a full recognition detector.
